measurement_method: Transform WGS84 vertices with project README local approximation; compare OSM outline and Indiana LiDAR-derived polygon in campus meters using Shapely. These source rings are independent of the model; this registration compares sources and current orthophoto, not a survey.

comparison.interpretation: OSM polygon matches the manifest wall/base footprint. The larger Indiana LiDAR outline has about 0.86 m centroid separation and better follows the 2022-2025 orthophoto roof edge; treat it as roof envelope rather than foundation.

orthophoto.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana Current Orthophotography ImageServer
orthophoto.coverage: 2022-2025, exact local capture date not available
orthophoto.limits: Used for plan and roof-outline registration only, not height, facade or dated renovation comparison.
